purpose: Teach: 招聘/来賓/一報/区役所/登用/譲り/心掛け/御礼

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外、本気で、絶対、招聘、絶対、研究員、絶対、知ってるか?本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — do you know about the overseas research fellow we're hosting? I'm asking you seriously.
lines.style: Direct, measured opening. Slight pause before the name to signal this matters. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who trusts you enough to assign you something real.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会、本気で、絶対、来賓、絶対、として、絶対、お出迎え、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I welcomed him at the conference as a distinguished guest. I'm grateful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. Clear, attentive — he's listening for what comes next. The sincerity of someone who takes a task seriously without overstating it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、新発見、本気で、絶対、一報、絶対、教授に、絶対、入れろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I need you to get word of this new finding to the department chair. Make it happen.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. A clear instruction, not a suggestion. He knows you're capable. The expectation is already built in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、区役所、絶対、で、絶対、住民票、絶対、取得しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I obtained his residential registration from the ward office. I took care of it.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact competence. No flourish. He's confirming the task is done. Quiet pride in handling details correctly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、若手研究員の、本気で、絶対、登用、絶対、努めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — make sure we're nurturing the junior researchers. That's on you.
lines.style: Expectation layered with trust. Said like he's reminding you of something you already believe. The weight of mentorship without the lecture.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先輩から、本気で、絶対、譲り、絶対、受けた、絶対、研究、絶対、大切にしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've been honoring the research that was passed down to me from my seniors. I value it deeply.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. He means this. Not defensive, but grounded. The kind of sincerity that comes from understanding why something matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究、本気で、絶対、心掛け、絶対、誠実に、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — keep your research grounded in integrity. Don't let that slip.
lines.style: The advice of someone who's seen researchers lose their way. Steady, almost gentle in delivery. Not accusing — protecting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指導教官への、本気で、絶対、御礼、絶対、文、絶対、お送りいたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I sent a thank-you letter to my faculty advisor. I wanted him to know.
lines.style: Soft close. Understated but genuine. He's saying something true without needing to expand on it. The kind of gratitude that lives in small actions.
